title: Air Quality Index Toolkit for Weathercasters
claims: Sensitive groups for ozone pollution include active children and adults, and people with lung disease.
Sensitive groups for particle pollution include people with heart or lung disease, older adults and children.
Symptoms such as unusual coughing, pain when taking a deep breath, chest tightness or wheezing are a signal to stop the activity and choose a less strenuous one.
People with lung disease who notice these symptoms when air is polluted should check with their doctor about what to do.
license: Public domain (US government work); cited with attribution

verification.note: PDF 正文可读，抓取到的是该件第 27 页起的 Civic Groups 章节，敏感人群定义与症状处置建议均在这一段正文中。PDF 无出版日期，属较早版本（AQI 最高档仍写作 very unhealthy/purple，为 2012 年前的分档表述），引用时应避免当作现行 AirNow 六档口径。

claimVerification.note: 原文：“Sensitive groups for ozone pollution include active children and adults, and people with lung disease.”
原文：“Sensitive groups for particle pollution include people with heart or lung disease, older adults, and children.”

原文：“If you notice symptoms when you’re outside, such as coughing, pain when taking a deep breath, chest tightness, or wheezing, stop what you’re doing and switch to a less strenuous activity.”（claim 的“unusual”在此段无对应词，属轻微修饰）。

原文：“Check with your doctor if you have these symptoms.”（针对所有出现症状者，不限肺病患者）；同段另有“People with heart disease should check with their doctor before engaging in vigorous outdoor exertion when particle levels are high.”，claim 只保留了其中一半，改写时勿省略心脏病提示。
